funding_cadence_rule: Eight-hour schedule is a research validation assumption for these three symbols, not a claim about all historical Bybit contracts. Any mismatch blocks replay pending a documented schedule amendment; never fill missing rates with zero.
incomplete_bars: Reject any candle whose closing boundary is later than response server time or capture receive time.
coverage: Every hourly trade and mark candle required over the entire fixed interval. Funding must include a pre-start anchor, uninterrupted assumed eight-hour cadence, and an event within eight hours of the exclusive end.
resumption: Rerun START_HISTORY.cmd to reuse only hash-verified successful pages with the identical protocol and collector source hashes. No automatic retry or alternate host; failed attempts remain in the evidence.
historical_status: Venue-transfer exploration on dates previously examined with Coinbase spot data, not untouched out-of-sample evidence.
